//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the CHECKBOX component — the custom tri-state checkbox `.pa-checkbox` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.checkbox/1`, svelte `forms/Checkbox.svelte`). SCOPE = the full blessed checkbox tree from snippets/forms.html:172-240: a `<label class="pa-checkbox ...">` wrapping a hidden native `<input type="checkbox">`, the drawn `<span class="pa-checkbox__box">`, and (when a label is set) a `<span class="pa-checkbox__label">`. Modifiers in main.css: size (xs/sm/lg/xl), label-end/start/top, x, disabled — all claimed. The box span is ALWAYS present; the label span only when `label` is supplied. disabled emits BOTH the `pa-checkbox--disabled` label class AND the native `disabled` on the input (snippets/forms.html:193-199 — core also auto-dims via :has(input:disabled), so the class is belt-and-suspenders). name/id/value/checked/required are NATIVE attrs on the <input>. The indeterminate state is JS-only (set via el.indeterminate, not an attribute — snippets/forms.html:185-191), so it is NOT a markup feature here. Both wrappers hardcode `type="checkbox"` on the input. The `pa-checkbox-group` container is a SEPARATE component (its own fixture). See input.json / timeline-item.json for the control-with-elements model.

propsVocabulary.size: xs|sm|lg|xl — scales the box (default is the unmodified md checkbox). Shared scale with input/select; emits pa-checkbox--{size}.
propsVocabulary.labelPosition: end|start|top — label placement relative to the box → pa-checkbox--label-{pos}. `end` is the visual default but still emits the (redundant, valid) class when set explicitly; unset = classless.
propsVocabulary.isXMark: boolean — swap the checkmark for an X (pa-checkbox--x), for excluded/blocked selections.
propsVocabulary.disabled: boolean — emits pa-checkbox--disabled on the label AND the native `disabled` attr on the input.
propsVocabulary.label: label text — rendered inside <span class="pa-checkbox__label">. When absent, no label span.
propsVocabulary.name: native name attribute on the <input>
propsVocabulary.id: native id attribute on the <input> (hand-set — normalizer keeps real ids)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the label (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature
